text: PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 111 (Kegalle) AMENDMENT THE following appendix is inserted to the Land Settlement Final Order Published under part III Lands in the Extra—Ordinary Gazette No.413/13 dated 08th August 1986 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka of the lands Situated in the village of Dodawatta (V.P. No. 747)in the Atulugam Korale East of the Three Korales and Lower Bulatgama division in Atulugam Korale East D.R.O’s Division (Now Deraniyagala Divisional Secretary’s Division) of the Kegalle District in the Sabaragamuwa Province.(Vide Settlement Notice No. 1848 (Kegalle)) Aඉඉൾඇൽංඑ I the undersigned hereby declare in pursuance of the powers conferred on me by section 5(7) of the Land Settlement Ordinance. That the Lands described as lot 118 now demarcated as sub divisional lost 744, 745, 746, 747 and 748 in the Village Plan No.747 (Sab) have ceased to be the subject of the legal proceedings under the Land Settlement Ordinance L. G. P. PRASAD. Assistant Settlement officer, Deputy Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla, 25th April, 2024. EOG 12 - 0155
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
